title: Tapped state wrong on created or found permanents (10 cards)
body:
Encoded tapped, but the text does not say tapped:

- Ashling's Command and Casey & Raph, Hotheads: Treasure tokens
- Kassandra, Eagle Bearer: found card
- Ghalta and Mavren: Vampire tokens (also encoded attacking)

Encoded untapped, but the text says "Gift a tapped Fish":

- Into the Flood Maw, Longstalk Brawl, Mind Spiral, Parting Gust, Pool Resources, Sazacap's Brew
